notes.title: Demo Updates Winding Down - Full Game Ramping Up!
notes.content: [h3]Greetings, adventurers![/h3][p]Now that Chapter 2 of [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i] has been added to the demo and a few key QoL enhancements have been delivered, you'll likely see fewer updates to the demo itself moving forward (certainly no additional content, but I will still be providing support in case of bugs etc.)[/p][p]This shift in focus is to allow me to focus on completing the remaining Chapters, of which there are eight planned - for a total of ten Chapters in the complete story - as well as to do a bit better job with promoting the project on various socials. I am hoping to be able to grow the wishlist rate on Steam as well as to accumulate more reviews for the demo (Positive reviews, ideally ːsteamthumbsupː), which will both help build momentum in anticipation of a 2027 release.[/p][p][/p][h3]Feedback still welcome[/h3][p]That said, I am still actively interested in feedback and identifying ways to improve the player experience. And to that end, I've entered [i]Moonfell[/i] into the latest Feedback Quest game jam, hosted by the Indie Questing folks, which you can find here: [url="https://itch.io/jam/feedback-quest-8-indiegames-x-indie-streamers"]🔥 Feedback Quest 8: indiegames X indie streamers - itch.io[/url][/p][p]There are tons of cool projects in this jam! And almost every genre imaginable is represented, including but not limited to other RPGs. So feel free to come and check out the indie games on display, and maybe rate / comment on a few projects if so inclined. Incidentally, [i]Moonfell[/i] was selected as the winner of Feedback Quest 6, so there's a lot riding on this![/p][p][i]OK not really, the competition is just for fun [/i]:)[/p][p][/p][h3]Thanks for your continued support![/h3][p]I appreciate every download, comment, wishlist, review, "let's play", and social media interaction. Indeed, the positive responses I've seen from players are a big motivating factor to keeping this project going strong.[/p][p]We even got featured on YouTube! Along with some other notable recent & upcoming RPG Maker projects.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ItxGumooyis?si=MgEnbKMXIjhlkhGM&t=704"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]So that's all for now, but I will be back with periodic teasers and further news posts as development continues.[/p][p]Until then![/p]

notes.title: Demo Updates!
notes.content: [p]Greetings, adventurers![/p][p]It's time for another update to the demo! While there won't be any major content additions until the release of the full game, there's still plenty of activity taking place to polish up the first two Chapters.[/p][p][b]Change log:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added all remaining passive skills and active skills to the main party's skill list[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced some Status conditions, hit % of status-inflicting skills, and duration[/p][/*][*][p]Positive changes to the party's TP now take effect the same turn they occur (for example, reviving a fallen member, or curing paralysis)[/p][/*][*][p]The side with Advantage in combat (if any) will begin the first turn with 1 bonus action / FP[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous dialog and tutorial fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the form-changing mechanics of the Krell battle[/p][/*][*][p]Custom mouse cursor added![/p][/*][*][p]Sanctuary Games splash screen added[/p][/*][*][p]Added some missing descriptors to various passive skills[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the Respawn prompts at Save Crystals when used in a "safe" area[/p][/*][*][p]Added some alternate dialog options when revisiting older areas, such as visiting Glancia Forest without Darren in the party[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error with the Halfmoon Blade's Damage stat[/p][/*][/list][p]There are probably a few things I have neglected to mention, but it's already quite a list! While I don't have any specific future updates planned for the demo, I am always eager to received feedback from players kind enough to try out the game. There's even a survey you can fill out upon completing the demo content, if so inclined.[/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who has downloaded the demo, left a review or comment, or even just read these little updates from time to time - your support means a ton![/p][p]Happy questing![/p][p]--Chris (developer, Runelight Owl)[/p]

notes.title: Small Patch - Quality Updates
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

This small update addresses a few minor issues and adds a subtle but (hopefully) impactful visual feature to enhance the player's experience!

[b]Change log:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fog and mist effects added to select maps
[*] Removed previous DMG nerf from Crossbows to compensate for their lower hit rates
[*] Added a few missing MP costs to skill item cards from the learning screen
[*] Game font can now only be changed from the title screen, however this change has enabled a fix to a previously reported issue where alternate fonts are too big for certain text boxes
[*] Miscellaneous mapping and eventing fixes
[/list]

I've been very pleased with player reception to Chapter 2 so far and hope to be able to continue developing Chapter 3 (and beyond) with a sense of momentum. Just a reminder, none of the upcoming content will be pushed to the demo moving forward, allowing me to focus on the remainder of the game.

Thanks to everyone who has downloaded the demo, left a review or comment, or even just read these little updates from time to time - your support means a ton!

Happy questing!

--Chris
(developer, Runelight Owl)

notes.title: Chapter 2 Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

I am proud to announce that the second chapter of [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i] is now available to the public! This continuation of the story delves further into the mystery of the Artifacts and the Royal Legacy, and introduces one of the primary antagonists our heroes will face throughout their adventure.

Also featured are some enhancements, re-balancing, and bug fixes pertaining to the Prelude and Chapter 1, along with some improvements to dialog and cutscenes.

[b]Chapter 2 Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] Overworld exploration
[*] A new party member
[*] Skill learning system
[*] New dungeons, enemies, and puzzles
[*] More secrets
[*] Equipment upgrade system
[*] Settlements and shops
[*] A new field skill!
[/list]

While Chapter 2 will be the final block of content released in the public demo, be assured that Chapter 3 (and beyond) are actively in development - stay tuned for more news on the full game!

Thanks to everyone who has supported this project, whether via downloading, reviewing, providing feedback, or just spreading the word. Happy adventuring!

--Chris
(lead developer, Runelight Owl)

notes.title: Chapter 2 & Demo Updates Almost Here!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

I am pleased to announce that Chapter 2 of [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i] has reached "alpha" status, meaning it's essentially complete, and undergoing some internal testing before the closed beta and subsequent release to Steam & other platforms.
The timeline is still subject to change depending on what comes about during testing, but I can optimistically say this update should go public within the next week or 10 days.

What can you expect from Chapter 2, and the related updates?
Some of the details are still under wraps of course, but here's a quick preview:
[list]
[*] Continue the story of the royal heirs as they learn more about the fall of the kingdom
[*] Learn about the mysterious faction pulling the strings
[*] 60-90+ Minutes Additional Content (about the size of the Prelude + Chapter 1)
[*] 1 New Playable Character
[*] 2 Additional Dungeons
[*] 3 Challenging Boss Battles
[*] Equipment Upgrades
[*] Skill Learning System
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who has supported the journey thus far.
Your downloads, comments, and reviews (P.S. the demo hit Positive rating with 10 reviews not too long ago!) really mean a lot!

--mooglerampage

notes.title: Demo Updates: Not Quite Chapter 2 (yet!)
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

It's been some time since the last demo update, and I've got some exciting things to share!

First, in the interest of transparency, I should clarify that this is NOT the Chapter 2 release - at least not yet. The goal of this release is to make the various story, gameplay, and UI/UX changes available now, in anticipation of Chapter 2's actual content being released towards the end of February or early March. If you've been following my posts on itch or Steam, the trend of Chapter 2's release date moving around isn't exactly new, but I am optimistic this date will stick.

So, what is in this build, you ask? Below is a fairly detailed, but probably still not comprehensive, list of enhancements:

[list]
[*] Improved face sprite for Spark
[*] Elder Troll damage and regeneration boost
[*] Added a Current Objectives option to Save crystals
[*] Controller button remapping in the Options menu
[*] Revised many tutorials for clarity
[*] Added a number display to the Synergy meter
[*] Enhanced several cutscenes
[*] Various dialog re-writes
[*] Changed the pop-up for Recovery Springs and Save Crystals so that it is less time consuming / repetitive
[*] The Prelude now has a few hidden items but is also easier to navigate if players stay on the critical path
[*] Moved around when certain tutorials trigger to be more intuitive
[*] Removed unnecessary "wait" time from certain text windows, particularly the dummy objects in the Glancia Temple Library
[*] Added Relics to the Items menu (under the Accessory category, with Rings as intended)
[*] A few mapping fixes such as bed sheets being on the correct layer above the player
[*] Hide crafting items that the player cannot have the components for based on game progression (less cluttered menu)
[*] Added more offensive skills to merfolk-type enemies
[*] Slightly re-balanced Zombie's attack damage
[/list]

Well, that's all for now, but I hope to be back soon with more content. Until then, happy adventuring!

P.S. Thanks for all your support - follows, downloads, ratings, etc. are always greatly appreciated.

--Chris (developer, Runelight Owl)

notes.title: Demo Updates - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

Chapter 2 of [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i] has been in the proverbial oven for some time, and I'm excited to be able to share it soon!

"How soon is [i]soon[/i]", you ask?
A fair question. I am estimating another month, give or take (so at the time of writing that would put us at late February).

While the development cycle has taken a bit longer than I'd have liked - owing to some complications in my personal / professional life, as well as good-old-fashioned scope creep within the project itself - my hope is that it will indeed be worth the wait.

The near-future plan is to release Chapter 2 and its related QoL / content updates as an update to the existing Demo, at which point it will be in what I'd consider a "final" state (issues or bugs notwithstanding).
In the long-term, Chapter 3 and all content thereafter will only be made available in the fully-released game. And to be honest, we're probably looking at Q3 or Q4 of 2026 for that to come to fruition.

That said, I'm hoping this upcoming Demo update will tide players over (no pun intended!) until the finished project launches.

Thanks to everyone who has played the game, left a rating (just one more until Positive status in the Steam store!), made a comment or otherwise engaged with Moonfell.
Happy adventuring!

--mooglerampage

notes.title: Demo Feature Updates and More!
notes.content:
​Changelog for this minor release:

[list]
[*] Added more detailed information to the Skills screen, including Costs, etc. such that more information can be gathered about a skill prior to Learning it
[*] Changed the format of restorative skills to read "Healing Power" and color coded the text accordingly, to make them easier to distinguish from damaging skills
[*] Added a missing sound effect to the Remedy Herb item animation
[*] Fixed a bug in which one of the Fort exterior guards could miraculously survive falling off the guard tower
[*] Slightly increased the base spell power of Darren's tier 1 elemental spells
[*] Added target level-scaling to ATK-Up, DEF-Up, and similar buffs
[*] Increased Spark's DEF and MGR contribution from levels
[*] Tweaked enemy TP growth rates
[*] Fixed a bug in which spamming the Cancel button on the title screen could navigate to an unintended menu
[/list]

Thanks for all of your support, and happy adventuring!

notes.title: Moonfell: the Tides of Aether - Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

The demo for [i]Moonfell: the Tides of Aether[/i], covering the prologue and chapter 1, has been updated with some new features, balance changes (especially to Expert Mode), and general improvements.

This release includes:

[list]
[*] Evaluate target status conditions by hovering the cursor over them (works with mouse and controller now!)
[*] In-battle Status menu available from the party command input window
[*] Enhanced cutscenes and some re-written dialog
[*] Fixed a bug where the party member faces wouldn't always show up on the Save screen
[*] The Options menu now displays F-key shortcuts for functions such as displaying FPS or changing screen size
[*] A few compass and minimap tweaks
[*] One of the bandits on the Fort exterior has a new interaction with Lunara's Arrow skill
[*] Improved item and skill list sorting
[*] Some general map fixes
[*] Expert Mode stat changes have been slightly reduced
[*] Regular enemies in Expert Mode now have a chance to spawn as a special Variant with additional abilities!
[*] Save Crystals in Expert Mode always respawn enemies for extra challenge
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who has played the demo! Your feedback, ratings, comments, and support are tremendously appreciated!

--Chris (Developer, Runelight Owl)
